constraints.subject: app.routes.*
constraints.justification: Route handlers must not access data models directly; the HTTP layer must not couple to the persistence layer

constraints.subject: app.routes.*
constraints.justification: If a route needs data, it calls the corresponding service function; routes depend on services for data access

constraints.subject: app.services.*
constraints.justification: Only the service layer may import from the data model module

note: Do NOT emit prohibits_dependency app.services.* -> app.models.*: services are the sanctioned path to models. The ADR constrains routes only; app.middleware and config.py are not named.

constraints.subject: app.routes.*
constraints.justification: Every API endpoint requires authentication enforced through the centralized auth middleware

note: Login and token-refresh endpoints under /auth are explicitly exempt; they are handled by the middleware itself, so no exception edge against app.middleware.auth should be emitted. app/routes/auth.py legitimately uses require_auth.
